OnFinality encoded this proposal incorrectly (treasury proposal #117) and thus they have proposed a new treasury proposal (#118) which includes the additional amount corresponding to the incorrectly encoded proposal's bond.

Know more about it here: [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/9428-high-performance-public-infrastructure-1st-oct-2022-to-8th-jan-2023](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/9428-high-performance-public-infrastructure-1st-oct-2022-to-8th-jan-2023)
